name: system-backbone-riser-pump-drain-20260716
goal: Make risers, service manifold, backflow, FDC, pump decisions, main drains, and auxiliary drains one source-bound design backbone shared by 2D plans, elevation/3D models, and AutoBid quantities so unresolved system infrastructure cannot silently underbid a project.
exit_criteria: each sprinkler system has a stable riser, control valve, main drain, inspector's test and drain, source-bound nominal sizes, and an exact 3D feed route from the shared service manifold
current flow-test evidence and an explicit source-backed required or not-required pump decision are mandatory
dry and preaction systems explicitly drain to the riser, and every trapped basin over five gallons is assigned to a designed auxiliary drain
the same stable component and route identities appear in plan2d and model3d outputs
AutoBid component quantities are derived from the backbone rather than a one-riser one-drain default
missing geometry, catalog identity, pump duty, drain outlet, or basin disposition blocks system-design and quote readiness
primary, adversarial, live API, hydraulic, drainage, build, rulebook, loop-guard, formal invariant, and brain postflight checks pass
